souloutplus.config.category.generic.desc: Soul out mode and camera behavior
souloutplus.config.crosshairSource.desc: Where clicks raycast from while soul out§7 (SOUL=camera ray + camera orientation; BODY=body ray (like Tweakeroo freeCameraPlayerInputs); OFF=block clicks)
souloutplus.config.cameraSpeed.desc: Flight speed multiplier of the soul camera
souloutplus.config.cameraInertia.desc: Whether soul flight has inertia decay
souloutplus.config.rememberCameraPos.des: Next soul out starts from the last soul position
Entity interact/attack also uses the camera ray (note: entity range is a separate attribute, vanilla 3 blocks)
souloutplus.config.conflictGuardNotice.d: Refuse soul out with a chat message when another mod controls the camera entity (no other mods modified)
souloutplus.config.placeRange.desc: Max soul-to-target distance for placing/interacting (blocks). 0=vanilla attribute
souloutplus.config.breakRange.desc: Max soul-to-target distance for breaking (blocks). 0=vanilla attribute
souloutplus.config.entityRange.desc: Max soul-to-target distance for entity interaction/attack. entity_interaction_range is a separate attribute (vanilla 3)
souloutplus.config.autoRaiseReachSinglep: In singleplayer with cheats, auto /attribute raise block/entity_interaction_range (max 64)
souloutplus.config.respectServerCap.desc: Clamp judgement to what the server actually allows (vanilla 4.5/3 on servers), avoid packets that will be rejected
souloutplus.config.vanillaRateLimit.desc: At most 1 place + 1 break per tick (same as vanilla client physical limit, anticheat friendly)
souloutplus.config.placementProtocol.des: Servux/built-in-server accurate placement: state encoded into hit position, placement no longer needs head rotation§7 (auto=only when detected)
souloutplus.config.useClientPrediction.d: Prefer the vanilla local prediction path (sounds/feedback), fall back to raw packets when disabled by other mods
souloutplus.config.waitServerHead.desc: For orientation-sensitive blocks (observer/piston/dispenser) wait until the server confirmed the head rotation synced (ABORT marker packet)
souloutplus.config.shiftStatePassthrough: Keep server sneak state = real shift key: shift+right-click on note block/trapdoor places the block instead of interacting
souloutplus.config.rejectedBlockFlash.de: Flash the block position red when the server rolls a placement back
souloutplus.config.ghostPreview.desc: Live wireframe preview of the block to be placed at the crosshair (with its orientation)
souloutplus.config.previewStyle.desc: Drawing style of the ghost preview
souloutplus.config.reachHudIndicator.des: Colored dot by the crosshair: green=reachable yellow=beyond config but server allows red=out of reach
souloutplus.config.showBodyInSoul.desc: Render your own body while soul out
souloutplus.config.toggleSoulOut.desc: Toggle soul out / return§7 (unbound by default, bind in Hotkeys tab)
souloutplus.config.openConfigGui.desc: Open the Soul Out Plus config screen§7 (unbound by default)
souloutplus.config.returnToBody.desc: Teleport the soul camera back above the body
souloutplus.config.snapAim.desc: While held, snap the soul view to the nearest of the 6 directions (for orientation-sensitive placement)
souloutplus.message.conflict_guard: §7[§dSoul§7]§c Soul out cancelled: another mod is controlling the camera entity (free-cam conflict)
